programme.title: Sa e ke numrin?
programme.desc: Anna Faris, Chris Evans. Një vajzë beson se shansi për të gjetur njeriun perfekt tashmë ka kaluar. E bindur se ndoshta njëri prej ish të dashurve është i duhuri, ajo përpiqet t’i takojë sërish për t’i dhënë vetes një mundësi të dytë...

programme.title: S1E21 - Të Gjithë Cmënden pas Rejmondit
programme.desc: Rei Barone i ka të gjitha në jetë: një familje të madhe, një punë të mirë dhe një shtëpi të bukur. Problemi i vetëm i tij janë prindërit dhe vëllai i tij xheloz, të cilët jetojnë në anën tjetër të rrugës. Telashet nuk kanë të sosur në këtë familje të madhe, por Reimondi ka mësuar si t’i përballojë ato.

programme.title: Journeys In India

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes
programme.sub-title: Desert Survival

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path

programme.desc: గాన్ ఫ్రీక్స్, అదృశ్యమైన తన తండ్రిని వెతకాలనే ఆశతో, అరుదైన రాక్షసులు, నిధిని వేటాడే హంటర్‌గా మారడానికి సిద్దమవుతాడు.

programme.desc: గాన్ ఫ్రీక్స్, అదృశ్యమైన తన తండ్రిని వెతకాలనే ఆశతో, అరుదైన రాక్షసులు, నిధిని వేటాడే హంటర్‌గా మారడానికి సిద్దమవుతాడు.

programme.title: వన్ పీస్
programme.sub-title: Monkey D Luffy, a young man made of rubber, and his team of pirates embark on an exciting adventure to find a fabled treasure
programme.desc: యువకుడు మంకీ డి లఫ్ఫీ, అతని సముద్రపు దొంగల బృందం ఒక కల్పిత నిధిని కనుగొనడానికి ఉత్తేజకరమైన సాహసయాత్రను ప్రారంభిస్తారు.

programme.title: కిటెరెట్సు

credits.actor: Toshiko Fujita (Kiteretsu),Kazuko Sugiyama (Korosuke),Chieko Honda (Miyo),Yuji Mitsuya (Tongari),Mami Koyama (Korosuke),Mayumi Sho (Miyo)

programme.title: హంటర్ X హంటర్
programme.sub-title: Gon Freecss sets out to become a Hunter, an elite professional known for hunting rare monsters and treasures, in the hopes of finding his absent father
programme.desc: గాన్ ఫ్రీక్స్, అదృశ్యమైన తన తండ్రిని వెతకాలనే ఆశతో, అరుదైన రాక్షసులు, నిధిని వేటాడే హంటర్‌గా మారడానికి సిద్దమవుతాడు.

programme.title: వన్ పీస్
programme.sub-title: Monkey D Luffy, a young man made of rubber, and his team of pirates embark on an exciting adventure to find a fabled treasure
programme.desc: యువకుడు మంకీ డి లఫ్ఫీ, అతని సముద్రపు దొంగల బృందం ఒక కల్పిత నిధిని కనుగొనడానికి ఉత్తేజకరమైన సాహసయాత్రను ప్రారంభిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Mayumi Tanaka (Monkey D Luffy),Kazuya Nakai (Roronoa Zoro),Akemi Okamura (Nami),Kappei Yamaguchi (Usopp),Hiroaki Hirata (Sanji),Mahito Ôba

programme.title: కిటెరెట్సు
programme.sub-title: Kiteretsu, an elementary school student who uses his inventions to help people, and Korosuke, his robot, partake in various adventures along with his friends
programme.desc: ప్రాథమిక పాఠశాల విద్యార్థి కిటెరెట్సు, అతని రోబోట్ కొరోసుకే తన స్నేహితులతో కలిసి వివిధ సాహసాలలో పాల్గొంటారు.

credits.actor: Toshiko Fujita (Kiteretsu),Kazuko Sugiyama (Korosuke),Chieko Honda (Miyo),Yuji Mitsuya (Tongari),Mami Koyama (Korosuke),Mayumi Sho (Miyo)

programme.title: వీ బేర్ బేర్స్
programme.sub-title: Three brother bears, Grizzly, Panda, and Ice, awkwardly navigate life in the San Francisco Bay Area as they try to fit into modern human society
programme.desc: గ్రిజ్లీ, పాండా, ఐస్ లు ఆధునిక మానవ జీవితాన్ని గడిపే క్రమంలో శాన్ ఫ్రాన్సిస్కో బే ఏరియాలో ఇబ్బందులు ఎదుర్కొంటారు.

credits.actor: Bobby Moynihan (Panda),Eric Edelstein (Grizzly),Demetri Martin (Ice Bear),Charlyne Yi (Chloe),Patton Oswalt (Nom Nom),Jason Lee (Charlie)

programme.title: లూనీ ట్యూన్స్ కార్టూన్స్
programme.sub-title: Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, Porky Pig, Sylvester, Tweety, Road Runner and many others go through a series of funny misadventures
programme.desc: బగ్స్ బన్నీ, డాఫీ డక్, పోర్కీ పిగ్, ట్వీటీ, రోడ్ రన్నర్, ఇతర పాత్రలు వరుస హాస్యాస్పదమైన సాహసాలను ఎదుర్కొంటాయి.

credits.actor: Eric Bauza (Bugs Bunny/Daffy Duck/Marvin the Martian/Tweety),Jeff Bergman (Elmer Fudd/Sylvester/Ralph Wolf),Bob Bergen (Porky Pig),Fred Tatasciore (Yosemite Sam/Gossamer/Sam Sheepdog),Candi Milo (Granny),Michael Ruocco (Beaky Buzzard)

programme.title: The Great Rhino Robbery
programme.sub-title: The trade in rhinos explodes as demand for their horns increases globally, leading poachers to start hunting the animals in the wild as the crimewave spirals into an existential crisis
programme.desc: In 2011, thieves started stealing rhino horns from museums and auction houses in a bizarrely British crime wave that swept the country, and the police were at a loss as to who was responsible.

credits.actor: Steven R. Galster,Paolo Viscardi,Paulo Mota,William Fowlds

programme.title: Cave Crocs of Gabon
programme.desc: Experts and cavers investigate a community of dwarf crocodiles living in a series of underground caves in the wilderness of Gabon.

programme.title: Africa's Trees of Life
programme.sub-title: Explore the importance of the sausage tree in sub-Saharan Africa's ecosystem and the vital role it plays in providing sustenance and sanctuary for local animals
programme.desc: Explore the importance of certain trees to the ecosystem of sub-Saharan Africa.

programme.title: The Americas
programme.sub-title: The Atlantic Coast, where wild horses battle, bald eagles chase ospreys and sharks protect fish; raccoons navigate city life, black bears search for food in ancient forests and a 130-year-old oak tree prepares for winter's arrival
programme.desc: Tom Hanks narrates a 10-episode television event exploring the worlds and wildlife of North and South America, following amazing creatures across frozen mountains, barren deserts and dense jungles in awe-inspiring, never-before-seen footage.

programme.title: Okavango: River of Dreams
programme.sub-title: Follows the life of lioness Fekeetsa as she travels around her territory in the Upper Okavango river
programme.desc: An exploration of the wildlife and landscapes of the Okavango River in Southern Africa, embarking on a journey along the river's path.

programme.title: Animal Armory
programme.sub-title: Bears, owls, and tigers use their sharp claws to fight and catch prey, while baboons, wolves and woodchucks use their teeth as weapons
programme.desc: Only the strongest survive in the animal kingdom, where the competition for food, territory or mates means employing skilfully crafted tricks of the trade. `Animal Armory' incorporates high-end imagery and computer graphics to reveal how wildlife use their teeth, claws, antlers, camouflage, venom and even spit to threaten and intimidate rivals and predators alike. With weapons of deception, animals disarm and entice prey to their death. Meanwhile, perhaps the oldest weapons employed by animals are projectiles, which have evolved into their own versions of poison-tipped harpoons, chemical missiles and high-powered bullets.

programme.title: Lion Queens: Fighting For Survival
programme.desc: Every year in Tanzania, the dry season hits the Ruaha reserve hard. To survive, animal populations come down from the high plateaus to reach the Ruaha river, where a troupe of lionesses waits patiently, poised for combat.

programme.title: Wild Cats
programme.sub-title: Sheds light on the wild cats of Africa's numerous challenges and how they adapt to thrive in their environment
programme.desc: From the mighty lions of Africa and the elusive snow leopards of Asia to the pumas of the North American mountains and the jaguars of the Amazon. These stunningly graceful animals are some of the most vicious and territorial on the planet.

programme.title: Animals At Night
programme.desc: Through the vicissitudes, discoveries and encounters of a young boar forgotten by its family, discover the heart of nocturnal life in nature, tracking the adventures and behaviors of animals in the darkness that has hidden them from us until now. A previously unimagined bustling of activity, that the very latest technology is now, paradoxically, bringing into the light of day.

programme.title: Big Beasts: Last of the Giants
programme.sub-title: Beginning in the Americas, Patrick finds out more about the planet's largest predator, the sperm whale, comes face to face with grizzlies, and gets up close with the anaconda as he reveals how these giants shape their environments
programme.desc: Shot across the continents of Australia, Asia, the Americas and Africa, this three-part nature documentary series delves into the Earth's biggest beasts, from five-ton elephant seals to the dignified African lion. Biologist Patrick Aryee embarks on a global mission to explore the biggest beasts and the conservation challenges that face them in an ever-changing world. Full of beautiful natural history photography, illustrated graphics of extinct gigantic beasts and stunning close encounters, this series looks at why size really does matter in the natural world.

programme.title: Wild Kingdoms
programme.sub-title: Rivers are the lifeblood Africa's arid landscapes. But while they offer sustenance, the kings of the water take no prisoners here
programme.desc: An unforgettable expedition across diverse landscapes of Africa exploring the fascinating lives of their extraordinary inhabitants.

programme.title: Japan's Wild Side
programme.sub-title: As winter's harshest period passes, the changing season ushers in new life and fresh challenges for Japan's wildlife
programme.desc: We travel from the forests of Hokkaido to the shores of Okinawa to uncover the secrets of Japan's most extraordinary creatures.

programme.title: Hot Life Africa
programme.sub-title: Being thin, having black patches on light-coloured fur, hyperventilating and licking itself regularly to evaporate saliva are the cheetah's most effective tricks to cope with its scorching environment
programme.desc: The threat of climate change is especially a risk for those living in the world's hottest regions, such as the Namib, the Kalahari and the Kaokoveld in the southern cone of Africa.

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas
programme.sub-title: Madagascar is home to strange animals not found anywhere else on Earth. When these animals fight for supremacy, their battles are just as strange -- from weird neck-wrestling weevils to ring-tailed lemur mums that go into battle with baby on board
programme.desc: From turf wars, to food fights, to mating mayhem, nature is all about competition and the quest to be the best. Every day, the planet is a battleground as animals go head-to-head with their own kind.

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas
programme.sub-title: Australia is home to an eclectic array of creatures, and the ways to succeed as an alpha are just as diverse. The beach turns into a duelling ground, and the outback becomes a boxing ring, as animals face off with their own kind
programme.desc: From turf wars, to food fights, to mating mayhem, nature is all about competition and the quest to be the best. Every day, the planet is a battleground as animals go head-to-head with their own kind.

programme.desc: Over two episodes, biologist Patrick Aryee goes on a journey to discover the amazing world of cat species that has spanned over 11 million years. While exploring the evolution of these mammals over the years Aryee also examines how these feline creatures have survived harsh environments, becoming king of the jungle as well as being a popular household pet. Cats are celebrated for their physical prowess, with their running, jumping and climbing skills second to no other animal in the world. programme.title: बेस्ट ऑफ़ क्राइम पेट्रोल
programme.sub-title: Some of the best cases of 'Crime Patrol', which investigates how innocent people turn into criminals due to the influence of evil in society
programme.desc: कार्यक्रम, 'क्राइम पेट्रोल' में हत्या, अपहरण, धोखाधड़ी और चोरी जैसे कई अपराधों से जुड़ी सच्ची कहानियों को नाट्य रूपांतरण के माध्यम से पेश किया जाता है।.

programme.title: बेस्ट ऑफ़ क्राइम पेट्रोल
programme.sub-title: Some of the best cases of 'Crime Patrol', which investigates how innocent people turn into criminals due to the influence of evil in society

programme.title: बेस्ट ऑफ क्राइम पेट्रोल - क्राइम पेट्रोल डायल 100
programme.sub-title: A compilation of some of the most spine-chilling cases from 'Crime Patrol Dial 100', which investigates murders, kidnappings and thefts among other heinous crimes
programme.desc: धारावाहिक 'क्राइम पैट्रोल डायल 100' से रोंगटे खड़े कर देने वाले मामलों का संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है, जो कई जघन्य अपराधों के अलावा हत्या, अपहरण, चोरी आदि की जाँच करता है।.

programme.title: क्राइम पेट्रोल 2.ओ
programme.sub-title: Zareen, a 19-year-old, is arranged to get married to Omaan as her father owes money to the family. However, Omaan's mother plans to go back on her promise and demand more from Zareen's father. Things take a dark turn when Zareen's family finds out
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता, वास्तविक जीवन के उत्पीड़न, अपहरण और हत्या जैसे आपराधिक मामलों का नाट्यरूपांतरण प्रस्तुत करते हैं।.

programme.title: बेस्ट ऑफ़ क्राइम पेट्रोल
programme.sub-title: A compilation of the best cases investigated in 'Crime Patrol' showcases people from different walks of life falling victim to the vices of others or their own
programme.desc: कार्यक्रम, 'क्राइम पेट्रोल' में हत्या, अपहरण, धोखाधड़ी और चोरी जैसे कई अपराधों से जुड़ी सच्ची कहानियों को नाट्य रूपांतरण के माध्यम से पेश किया जाता है।.

programme.title: क्राइम पेट्रोल: 48 घंटे
programme.sub-title: A young woman and her father are brutally murdered before the former's wedding. However, police investigating the case stumble upon a shocking family secret

programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: एपीक खोज

programme.title: टेल्स ऑफ वेलोर
programme.sub-title: Indian soldiers narrate their stories of bravery from the wars that they fought for India. These soldiers went beyond their expected duties to protect their motherland
programme.desc: भारतीय सैनिक, देश के लिए बहादुरी से लड़े गए युद्ध की कहानियाँ सुनाते हैं। इन सैनिकों ने अपनी मातृभूमि की रक्षा के लिए अपने अपेक्षित कर्तव्यों से आगे बढ़कर काम किया।.

programme.title: भारत रत्न
programme.sub-title: The host sheds light on the untold events and stories related to the eminent personalities who have been awarded the Bharat Ratna for their contribution to society
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता उन प्रतिष्ठित व्यक्तियों से जुड़ी अनकही घटनाओं और कहानियों के बारे में बताते हैं, जिन्हें समाज में उनके योगदान के लिए भारत रत्न से सम्मानित किया गया है।.

programme.title: राजा रसोई और अन्य कहानियाँ

programme.desc: कथावाचक, भारत के कई क्षेत्रों के स्थानीय व्यंजनों और भारतीय राजघरानों की असाधारण पाक परंपराओं के बारे में जानकारी प्रदान करते हैं।.

programme.desc: कथावाचक, भारत के कई क्षेत्रों के स्थानीय व्यंजनों और भारतीय राजघरानों की असाधारण पाक परंपराओं के बारे में जानकारी प्रदान करते हैं।.

programme.title: राजा रसोई और अंदाज़ अनोखा
programme.sub-title: A renowned Indian chef shares the recipes of a variety of mouthwatering dishes and demonstrates the steps involved in their preparation
programme.desc: एक प्रसिद्ध भारतीय शेफ कई तरह के स्वादिष्ट व्यंजनों की रेसिपी साझा करते हैं और स्टेप बाइ स्टेप उसे बनाकर दिखाते हैं।.

programme.title: एपिक टेल्स ऑफ लव
programme.sub-title: A compilation of some of the most popular love stories featuring legendary characters based on various significant Indian historical and cultural legends
programme.desc: विभिन्न महत्वपूर्ण भारतीय ऐतिहासिक और सांस्कृतिक किंवदंतियों पर आधारित पौराणिक पात्रों वाली कुछ सबसे लोकप्रिय प्रेम कहानियों का संकलन।.

programme.title: जायंट हब्स
programme.sub-title: The people behind major transport hubs around the world reveal what it takes to get millions of commuters and tons of cargo to their destinations every day
programme.desc: दुनिया भर में प्रमुख परिवहन केन्द्रों के पीछे काम करने वाले लोग बताते हैं, कि हर दिन लाखों यात्रियों और टन भर माल को उनके गंतव्य तक पहुंचाने के लिए कितनी मेहनत लगती है।.

programme.title: एपिपीडिया
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker sheds light on the lesser-known facts about the country of India through voyages that have enabled the documentation of the evolution of India
programme.desc: फिल्म निर्माता भारत के विकास को दिखाने के लिए, यात्राओं के माध्यम से भारत देश के ऐसे तथ्यों के बारे में बताते हैं जो पूर्णता ज्ञात नहीं है।.

programme.title: डिस्ट्रक्शन डिकोडेड
programme.sub-title: An in-depth look at catastrophic events, analysing the science behind natural and man-made disasters and exploring the causes and consequences through expert insights and CGI visuals

programme.title: द ग्रेट इस्केप
programme.sub-title: Various artists re-enact the bravest escapes from captivity that prominent personalities have executed in the past across the world
programme.desc: विभिन्न कलाकार कैद से भागने की उन बहादुरीपूर्ण घटनाओं का पुनः मंचन करते हैं, जिन्हें प्रमुख लोगों ने अतीत में विश्व के विभिन्न भागों में अंजाम दिया था।.

programme.title: డేంజర్ మౌస్
programme.sub-title: Danger Mouse, a talented secret agent, and his faithful sidekick, Ernest Penfold, do all they can to thwart the evil plans of Baron Silas von Greenback
programme.desc: రహస్య ఏజెంట్ డేంజర్ మౌస్, ఎర్నెస్ట్ పెన్ఫోల్డ్ తో కలిసి గ్రీన్ బ్యాక్ దుష్ట ప్రణాళికలను అడ్డుకోడానికి ప్రత్నిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Alexander Armstrong (Danger Mouse),Dave Lamb,Kevin Eldon (Penfold),Stephen Fry (Colonel K)

programme.title: ఖుషీ రాముడు
programme.sub-title: Rama, together with his siblings and companions, embarks on numerous adventures while undergoing training at Vashist Ashram Gurukul
programme.desc: రాముడు, తన సోదరులు మరియు సహచరులతో కలిసి, వశిష్ఠ ఆశ్రమ గురుకులంలో శిక్షణ పొందుతూ అనేక సాహసయాత్రలను చేపడతాడు.

programme.title: వేక్ అప్ మ్యూజిక్ ఐడీ
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive collection of refreshing songs to help audiences kick-start the day, featuring popular artists and bands
programme.desc: ప్రముఖ కళాకారులు, బ్యాండ్‌ల పాటలతో, శ్రోతలు తమ రోజును ఉత్సాహంగా ప్రారంభించడానికి సహాయపడే ఉత్తేజకరమైన పాటల సమగ్ర సమాహారం.

programme.title: పంచతంత్ర నీతి కథలు
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of stories from the Panchatantra, a collection of Indian fables, that helps to instil morals and values in children
programme.desc: భారతీయ నీతి కథల సమాహారమైన, పంచతంత్ర కథల సమగ్ర సంకలనం, ఇది పిల్లలలో నైతికత, విలువలను పెంపొందించడానికి సహాయపడుతుంది.

programme.title: హ్యాపీ బర్త్ డే
programme.sub-title: Children celebrate their birthdays with a heart-touching note from their loved ones on the occasion of the special memorable day
programme.desc: పిల్లలు తమకు ఎంతో ప్రత్యేకమైన రోజు నాడు, తమ ప్రియమైన వారి నుండి హృదయాన్ని హత్తుకునే సందేశాలతో పుట్టినరోజు జరుపుకుంటారు.

programme.title: సూపర్ సింగూ
programme.desc: Super Singhoo.

programme.title: డోరా ప్రయాణం
programme.sub-title: A seven-year-old courageous girl, Dora, embarks on a trip with her best friend, Boots, in order to find something that interests her
programme.desc: ఏడేళ్ల అమ్మాయి డోరా తనకు ఆసక్తి ఉన్నదాన్ని కనుగొనడానికి తన స్నేహితుడు బూట్స్‌తో కలిసి విహారయాత్రకు బయలుదేరుతుంది.

programme.desc: Akira Mariyu Mowgli: The Jungle Book Sahasaalu.

programme.title: లిటిల్ కృష్ణ

programme.desc: కొంటెవాడైన చిన్ని కృష్ణుడు, ప్రజలపైకి భయంకర రాక్షసులను పంపిన దుష్ట కంసుడి నుండి బృందావన ప్రజలను కాపాడాలనుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: హైడీ
programme.sub-title: Heidi lives in Frankfurt and has a friend, Clara. However, after spending time at her grandfather's place in the countryside, she yearns to go back and spend time in the open mountain pasture
programme.desc: తన తాతయ్య అల్పోహితో కలిసి ఉండడానికి స్విస్ ఆల్ప్స్ వెళ్లిన హైడీ పట్ల ఆమె తాతయ్య అమితమైన ప్రేమను ఏర్పరచుకుంటాడు.

programme.desc: పాండా, కోడిపుంజు స్నేహితులై సాంస్కృతిక వైవిధ్యాన్ని ప్రోత్సహిస్తూ, వివిధ దేశాల ఉత్సాహభరితమైన సంస్కృతులను అన్వేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: పంచతంత్ర నీతి కథలు
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of stories from the Panchatantra, a collection of Indian fables, that helps to instil morals and values in children
programme.desc: భారతీయ నీతి కథల సమాహారమైన, పంచతంత్ర కథల సమగ్ర సంకలనం, ఇది పిల్లలలో నైతికత, విలువలను పెంపొందించడానికి సహాయపడుతుంది.

programme.title: అకిరా మరియు మోగ్లీ: ది జంగిల్ బుక్ సాహసాలు
programme.desc: Akira Mariyu Mowgli: The Jungle Book Sahasaalu.

programme.title: లిటిల్ కృష్ణ
programme.sub-title: Little Krishna, a mischievous child, lives in the village of Vrindavan. He decides to save the villagers from an evil king, Kamsa, who sends ferocious demons upon them
programme.desc: కొంటెవాడైన చిన్ని కృష్ణుడు, ప్రజలపైకి భయంకర రాక్షసులను పంపిన దుష్ట కంసుడి నుండి బృందావన ప్రజలను కాపాడాలనుకుంటాడు.

credits.actor: Prachi Save Saathi,Meghna Erande,Neil D'Monte,Anand Tiwari,Vikrant Chaturvedi,Soniya Nair,Cara Pareira

programme.title: సూపర్ సింగూ
programme.desc: Super Singhoo.

programme.title: మహా గణేశా
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: అత్యుత్తమ టెలివిజన్ కార్యక్రమాలు.

programme.title: పాండా మరియు రూస్టర్ సాహసాలు
programme.sub-title: A Panda and a rooster become friends as they set out on exciting adventures to explore the vibrant cultures of various countries while promoting the concept of cultural diversity

programme.title: హైడీ
programme.sub-title: Heidi lives in Frankfurt and has a friend, Clara. However, after spending time at her grandfather's place in the countryside, she yearns to go back and spend time in the open mountain pasture
programme.desc: తన తాతయ్య అల్పోహితో కలిసి ఉండడానికి స్విస్ ఆల్ప్స్ వెళ్లిన హైడీ పట్ల ఆమె తాతయ్య అమితమైన ప్రేమను ఏర్పరచుకుంటాడు.

credits.actor: Kristin Fiedler (Heidi),Thomas Ohrner (Peter),Erik Jelde (Alm-Öhi),Ursula Wolff (Klara),Tilly Lauenstein (Fräulein Rottenmeier),Leon Rainer

programme.title: పంచతంత్ర నీతి కథలు సరి కొత్త
programme.sub-title: Moral-filled tales come to life as engaging characters navigate challenges, teaching lessons on wisdom, honesty and friendship through captivating storytelling
programme.desc: పాత్రలు సవాళ్లను అధిగమించి, జ్ఞానం, నిజాయితీ, స్నేహంపై పాఠాలను బోధించడం ద్వారా నైతికతతో నిండిన కథలు ప్రాణం పోసుకుంటాయి.

programme.title: శక్తిమాన్
programme.sub-title: A young college boy discovers his yogic superpowers and transforms into a superhero who protects the world from an evil villain
programme.desc: ఒక కళాశాల యువకుడు తన శక్తులను కనుగొని ప్రపంచాన్ని ఒక దుష్ట విలన్ నుండి రక్షించే సూపర్ హీరో గా రూపాంతరం చెందుతాడు.

programme.title: పాండా మరియు రూస్టర్ సాహసాలు
programme.sub-title: A Panda and a rooster become friends as they set out on exciting adventures to explore the vibrant cultures of various countries while promoting the concept of cultural diversity
programme.desc: పాండా, కోడిపుంజు స్నేహితులై సాంస్కృతిక వైవిధ్యాన్ని ప్రోత్సహిస్తూ, వివిధ దేశాల ఉత్సాహభరితమైన సంస్కృతులను అన్వేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: డేంజర్ మౌస్
programme.sub-title: Danger Mouse, a talented secret agent, and his faithful sidekick, Ernest Penfold, do all they can to thwart the evil plans of Baron Silas von Greenback
programme.desc: రహస్య ఏజెంట్ డేంజర్ మౌస్, ఎర్నెస్ట్ పెన్ఫోల్డ్ తో కలిసి గ్రీన్ బ్యాక్ దుష్ట ప్రణాళికలను అడ్డుకోడానికి ప్రత్నిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Alexander Armstrong (Danger Mouse),Dave Lamb,Kevin Eldon (Penfold),Stephen Fry (Colonel K)

programme.title: ఖుషీ రాముడు
programme.sub-title: Rama, together with his siblings and companions, embarks on numerous adventures while undergoing training at Vashist Ashram Gurukul
programme.desc: రాముడు, తన సోదరులు మరియు సహచరులతో కలిసి, వశిష్ఠ ఆశ్రమ గురుకులంలో శిక్షణ పొందుతూ అనేక సాహసయాత్రలను చేపడతాడు.

programme.title: వేక్ అప్ మ్యూజిక్ ఐడీ
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive collection of refreshing songs to help audiences kick-start the day, featuring popular artists and bands
programme.desc: ప్రముఖ కళాకారులు, బ్యాండ్‌ల పాటలతో, శ్రోతలు తమ రోజును ఉత్సాహంగా ప్రారంభించడానికి సహాయపడే ఉత్తేజకరమైన పాటల సమగ్ర సమాహారం.

programme.title: డోరా ప్రయాణం

programme.desc: ఏడేళ్ల అమ్మాయి డోరా తనకు ఆసక్తి ఉన్నదాన్ని కనుగొనడానికి తన స్నేహితుడు బూట్స్‌తో కలిసి విహారయాత్రకు బయలుదేరుతుంది.

programme.sub-title: Little Hakka uses her magical 'Hakka Hat' to fight evil forces threatening nature in an animated children's adventure story
programme.desc: లిటిల్ హక్కా యానిమేటెడ్ పిల్లల సాహస కథలో ప్రకృతిని బెదిరించే దుష్ట శక్తులతో పోరాడడానికి 'హక్కా టోపీ'ని ఉపయోగిస్తుంది.

programme.desc: రాముడు, తన సోదరులు మరియు సహచరులతో కలిసి, వశిష్ఠ ఆశ్రమ గురుకులంలో శిక్షణ పొందుతూ అనేక సాహసయాత్రలను చేపడతాడు.

programme.title: వేక్ అప్ మ్యూజిక్ ఐడీ
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive collection of refreshing songs to help audiences kick-start the day, featuring popular artists and bands
programme.desc: ప్రముఖ కళాకారులు, బ్యాండ్‌ల పాటలతో, శ్రోతలు తమ రోజును ఉత్సాహంగా ప్రారంభించడానికి సహాయపడే ఉత్తేజకరమైన పాటల సమగ్ర సమాహారం.

programme.title: పంచతంత్ర నీతి కథలు
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of stories from the Panchatantra, a collection of Indian fables, that helps to instil morals and values in children
programme.desc: భారతీయ నీతి కథల సమాహారమైన, పంచతంత్ర కథల సమగ్ర సంకలనం, ఇది పిల్లలలో నైతికత, విలువలను పెంపొందించడానికి సహాయపడుతుంది.

programme.title: హ్యాపీ బర్త్ డే
programme.sub-title: Children celebrate their birthdays with a heart-touching note from their loved ones on the occasion of the special memorable day
programme.desc: పిల్లలు తమకు ఎంతో ప్రత్యేకమైన రోజు నాడు, తమ ప్రియమైన వారి నుండి హృదయాన్ని హత్తుకునే సందేశాలతో పుట్టినరోజు జరుపుకుంటారు.

programme.title: సూపర్ సింగూ
programme.desc: Super Singhoo.

programme.title: డోరా ప్రయాణం
programme.sub-title: A seven-year-old courageous girl, Dora, embarks on a trip with her best friend, Boots, in order to find something that interests her
programme.desc: ఏడేళ్ల అమ్మాయి డోరా తనకు ఆసక్తి ఉన్నదాన్ని కనుగొనడానికి తన స్నేహితుడు బూట్స్‌తో కలిసి విహారయాత్రకు బయలుదేరుతుంది.

programme.title: छोटा भीम
programme.sub-title: Bheem is an extremely brave, strong and intelligent young boy. He often manages to solve everyone's problems which endears him to the townspeople of Dholakpur
programme.desc: भीम एक असाधारण, शक्तिशाली और बुद्धिमान लड़का है। गाँव के सभी बच्चे उसे पसंद करते हैं, क्योंकि वह सभी की समस्याओं को हल करने में उनकी मदद करता है।.

programme.title: ग्रिजी एण्ड द लेम्मिंग्स
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: ग्रिज़ी नामक भालू, हर बार जब वन रेंजर घर छोड़ता है तो उसके घर में रहता है और उसे अपना घर मानता है। हालाँकि, जब लेमिंग्स की एक जनजाति उसी घर में रहने आती है तो चीजें बदल जाती हैं।.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.title: द अमेरिकाज़

programme.desc: Tom Hanks narrates a 10-episode television event from the executive producers of Planet Earth, exploring the extraordinary worlds and wildlife of North and South America. Scored by composer Hans Zimmer, the breathtaking journey follows amazing creatures living in their natural habitats across the supercontinent, including diverse terrains like the Atlantic Coast, Mexico, Wild West, Amazon, Frozen North, Gulf Coast, Andes, Caribbean, West Coast and Patagonia. Each location comes alive in never-before-seen footage showing the unique connectedness of the land that millions of people call home.

programme.title: ओकवांगो: रिवर ऑफ ड्रीम्स

programme.desc: फिल्ममेकर, दक्षिणी अफ्रीका की ऊपरी ओकावांगो नदी में और उसके आसपास पाए जाने वाले जीवों पर प्रकाश डालते हैं, जहाँ शाकाहारी और मांसाहारी जीव सह-अस्तित्व में रहते हैं।.

programme.title: एनिमल आरमोरी

programme.title: सर्वाइविंग अर्थ
programme.desc: From the producers of Walking with Dinosaurs comes an eight-part docuseries spanning 450 million years that revisits eight of Earth's major extinction events. Bringing some of the planet's most extraordinary geological eras to vivid life, the all-new footage created in partnership with real scientific insight explores the lives of animals we know and love, including mammoths, saber-toothed cats and dinosaurs, alongside some of evolution's truly unique creatures, like gorgonopsians, pliosaurs, glyptotherium and more. Together, they tell the story of how life has endured the impossible -- and never stopped fighting for survival.

programme.desc: Her actual name is Sandra Lee, but she is so popular in her field of dermatology that she is known by most people as Dr. Pimple Popper. programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.sub-title: A marine biologist and a special forces veteran battle the risk of hypothermia as they try to survive the harsh Canadian wilderness with nothing on
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: आचार्य समय सागर जी महाराज प्रवचन

programme.title: भजन
programme.sub-title: An engaging compilation of spiritual hymns and divine melodies presented by renowned devotional singers from across the globe
programme.desc: दुनिया भर के प्रसिद्ध भक्ति गायकों द्वारा प्रस्तुत आध्यात्मिक भजनों और दिव्य धुनों का एक आकर्षक संकलन की प्रस्तुति।.

programme.title: रामाशीष जी
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of the Almighty and encourages the followers to take the path of spirituality
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक ईश्वर की शिक्षाओं पर प्रकाश डालते हैं और अनुयायियों को आध्यात्मिकता का मार्ग अपनाने के लिए प्रेरित करते हैं।.

programme.title: नारायण सेवा संस्थान
programme.sub-title: A profound religious society highlights charitable services, spiritual guidance and holy discourses, providing support for the destitute and needy
programme.desc: एक गहन धार्मिक समाज, धर्मार्थ सेवाओं, आध्यात्मिक मार्गदर्शन और पवित्र प्रवचनों पर प्रकाश डालता है, तथा निराश्रितों और जरूरतमंदों को सहायता प्रदान करता है।.

programme.title: भजन

programme.title: श्री सत्यमित्रानंद जी महाराज
programme.sub-title: Shri Satyamitranand Ji Maharaj, a religious leader, delivers a discourse and shares the teachings and philosophies of the holy scriptures, inspiring devotees to lead a righteous life
programme.desc: धर्मगुरु श्री सत्यमित्रानंद जी महाराज प्रवचन देते हैं और पवित्र शास्त्रों की शिक्षाएँ और दर्शन साझा करते हैं, तथा भक्तों को धार्मिक जीवन जीने के लिए प्रेरित करते हैं।.

programme.title: पूज्य कौशिक जी महाराज
programme.sub-title: An eminent spiritual leader provides a comprehensive and detailed insight into important teachings and guides people on the right path
programme.desc: एक प्रख्यात आध्यात्मिक पथ-प्रदर्शक महत्वपूर्ण शिक्षाओं के बारे में व्यापक और विस्तृत अंतर्दृष्टि प्रदान करते हैं और लोगों को सही मार्ग पर मार्गदर्शन करते हैं।.

programme.title: पूज्य ऋषि जी महाराज
programme.desc: Pujya Rishi Ji Maharaj.

programme.title: स्वामी आशुतोषानंद गिरि जी महाराज
programme.desc: Swami Ashutoshanand Giri ji Maharaj.

programme.title: आराधना
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional songs sung to express veneration for divine figures in a bid to imbibe a sense of peace and calm in devotees
programme.desc: भक्तों में शांति और स्थिरता की भावना पैदा करने के उद्देश्य से दिव्य व्यक्तियों के प्रति श्रद्धा व्यक्त करने के लिए गाए गए भक्ति गीतों के व्यापक संकलन की प्रस्तुति।.

programme.title: भजन
programme.sub-title: An engaging compilation of spiritual hymns and divine melodies presented by renowned devotional singers from across the globe
programme.desc: दुनिया भर के प्रसिद्ध भक्ति गायकों द्वारा प्रस्तुत आध्यात्मिक भजनों और दिव्य धुनों का एक आकर्षक संकलन की प्रस्तुति।.

programme.title: सेल्फ रीअलिज़ेशन विथ साध्वी भगवती
programme.sub-title: The host engages in a discussion with a spiritual leader about life wisdom and pursuing the path of spirituality and devotion
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता एक आध्यात्मिक पथप्रदर्शक के साथ जीवन ज्ञान और आध्यात्मिकता तथा भक्ति के मार्ग पर चलने के बारे में चर्चा करते हैं।.

programme.title: संकीर्तन
programme.sub-title: A famous religious leader sings hymns in praise of Lord Krishna in front of devotees in a bid to imbibe a sense of peace in them
programme.desc: एक प्रसिद्ध धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक भक्तों में शांति की भावना पैदा करने के लिए उनके सामने भगवान कृष्ण की स्तुति में भजन गाते हैं।.

programme.title: पूज्य गुरु मी मां जी
programme.sub-title: Pujya Guru Mee Maa ji
programme.desc: विषय विशेषज्ञ वेल्डिंग जोड़ों और उनकी कमियों पर प्रासंगिक उदाहरणों सहित व्यापक और विस्तृत व्याख्यान प्रस्तुत करते हैं।.

programme.title: सत्संग-अमृत
programme.sub-title: A spiritual leader explores the path to a pious life through the wisdom of Hinduism, sharing timeless precepts as well as teachings
programme.desc: एक आध्यात्मिक पथ-प्रदर्शक हिंदू धर्म के ज्ञान के माध्यम से पवित्र जीवन के मार्ग की खोज कर, कालातीत उपदेशों के साथ-साथ शिक्षाओं को भी साझा करते हैं।.

programme.title: आचार्य बालकृषण जी
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the benefits of 'Ayurveda' and shares various treatments to help patients suffering from various ailments
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, 'आयुर्वेद' के लाभों पर प्रकाश डालते हैं तथा विभिन्न बीमारियों से पीड़ित रोगियों की मदद के लिए विभिन्न उपचार बताते हैं।.

programme.title: मोरारी बापू
programme.sub-title: Morari Bapu reads out and explains significant excerpts from the Rama Katha while giving his interpretation of the same and highlighting its importance
programme.desc: मोरारी बापू रामकथा के महत्वपूर्ण अंश पढ़ते और समझाते हैं, साथ ही उसकी अपनी व्याख्या और उसके महत्व पर प्रकाश डालते हैं।.

programme.title: योगऋषि स्वामी रामदेवजी महाराज
programme.sub-title: Baba Ramdev, a spiritual leader, delivers a discourse on spirituality and demonstrates various yoga asanas that enable oneself to lead a healthy and active lifestyle
programme.desc: आध्यात्मिक गुरु बाबा रामदेव आध्यात्मिकता पर प्रवचन देते हैं और विभिन्न योग आसनों का प्रदर्शन करते हैं जो स्वस्थ और सक्रिय जीवनशैली जीने में सक्षम बनाते हैं।.

programme.title: जतिन अग्रवाल जी
programme.sub-title: Jatin Agrawal Ji sings a series of soulful and melodious devotional songs in praise of the Almighty to foster a deep spiritual connection for the listeners
programme.desc: जतिन अग्रवाल जी सर्वशक्तिमान की स्तुति में हृदयस्पर्शी और मधुर भक्ति गीतों की एक श्रृंखला प्रस्तुत करते हैं, ताकि श्रोताओं के भीतर आध्यात्मिक जुड़ाव स्थापित हो सके।.

programme.title: महावीर शर्मा जी
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional songs, hymns and sacred chants in praise of the Almighty is played back-to-back
programme.desc: ईश्वर की स्तुति में भक्ति गीतों, भजनों और पवित्र मंत्रों का व्यापक संकलन लगातार प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।.

programme.title: कृषण भैया सिरसा वाले
programme.sub-title: Bhaiya Krishan Das, a spiritual adept, reads passages and sacred verses from a religious text, explains their meaning and further sings hymns with the devotees
programme.desc: आध्यात्मिक गुरु भैया कृष्ण दास धार्मिक ग्रंथों से कुछ अंश और पवित्र श्लोक पढ़ते हुए उनका अर्थ समझाते हैं और भक्तों के साथ भजन गाते हैं।.

programme.desc: விஜய், தனது சகோதரி சீதாவை பாலியல் பலாத்காரம் செய்து கொலை செய்த ஊழல் அரசியல்வாதியின் மகனைப் பழிவாங்கத் துடிக்கிறார்.

programme.title: ராஜ் மெலடீஸ்

programme.title: துனை

programme.desc: மாற்றாந்தாய் உடன்பிறப்புகளை ஆதரிக்கும் வித்யா, மோசடிக்காரர் என்பதை அறியாமல் ஒருவரை திருமணம் செய்துகொள்கிறாள்.

programme.desc: வெங்கய்யன் தந்தையை கொன்று, மக்களை அடிமைப்படுத்தினான் தீயவன். அறிவில்லாத வெங்கய்யனை ஜீவா புத்திசாலியாக்க உதவுகிறார்.

programme.sub-title: A genius music director, Damodaran, sinks into depression when his wife dies and his son, Krishna, becomes an alcoholic due to heartbreak. An old friend, Dr Priya, helps him with all his problems
programme.desc: இசையமைப்பாளர் தாமோதரன்,அவரின் மனைவி இறந்தபின் மகனும் குடிகாரனாக அவரது துன்பத்தை நீக்க பிரியா உதவுகிறார்.

programme.title: பெரிய இடத்து மாப்பிள்ளை
programme.sub-title: Two cousins, Lakshmi and Priya, fall in love with the same man, Gopalakrishnan, their families' driver, getting him into serious trouble
programme.desc: உறவினர்களான லக்ஷ்மி மற்றும் பிரியா குடும்ப ஓட்டுநரான கோபாலகிருஷ்ணனை காதலிக்கும்போது கடுமையான பிரச்சினையில் சிக்குகிறார்.

programme.title: மெகா டென் மூவிஸ்
programme.sub-title: The host presents an in-depth analysis and review of the top ten movies of the week and gives a short summary of the storylines
programme.desc: வாரத்தின் சிறந்த பத்து திரைப்படங்களின் பகுப்பாய்வு மற்றும் மதிப்பாய்வை வழங்கி சுருக்கத்தையும் வழங்கும் தொகுப்பாளர்.

programme.title: கோயில் காளை
programme.sub-title: A man devoted to temple life encounters an orphaned woman and fate unites them in marriage. However, complications arise when her true identity comes to light
programme.desc: கோவில் வாழ்க்கைக்கு அர்ப்பணிப்புடன் இருக்கும் ஆண், ஒரு அனாதை பெண்ணை சந்திக்கிறான், விதி அவர்களை திருமணத்தில் இணைக்கிறது.

programme.title: சவரிக்காடு
programme.sub-title: A group of friends decides to travel to Savarikkadu despite learning about the mysteries surrounding the place. Later, they get lost in the forest and try to find each other
programme.desc: மர்மங்கள் நிறைந்த சவரிக்காட்டுக்கு சென்று, தொலைந்து போகும் நண்பர்கள் ஒருவரையொருவர் கண்டுபிடிக்க முயற்சிக்கின்றனர்.

programme.title: உயிர்
programme.sub-title: Sundar lives with his brother's family but is unaware that his sister-in-law Arundathi lusts for him. After his brother's suicide, Sundar is forced to look after Arundathi and her children
programme.desc: சுந்தர் தனது சகோதரனின் குடும்பத்துடன் வசிக்கிறார், ஆனால் அவரது மைத்துனி அருந்ததி அவர் மீது ஆசைப்படுவதை அறியவில்லை.

programme.title: ஆனந்த்
programme.sub-title: Ananda, a popular singer, desperately seeks to win Latha's affection. Upon finally winning her heart, they decide to marry, but a series of misunderstandings soon separates them
programme.desc: பிரபல பாடகரான ஆனந்தா, தீவிரமாக லாதவை காதலித்து இருவரும் மணந்துகொள்ள நினைக்கும்போது தவறான புரிதல் அவர்களை பிரிக்கிறது.

programme.title: వందేమాతరం సాంగ్
programme.sub-title: A compilation of patriotic songs glorifying the greatness and unity of India and performed by various artists is played back to back
programme.desc: భారతదేశ గొప్పతనాన్ని మరియు ఐక్యతను కీర్తిస్తూ వివిధ కళాకారులు ప్రదర్శించే దేశభక్తి గీతాల త్వరితగతిన ప్రసారం చేస్తారు.

programme.title: నాదస్వరం
programme.sub-title: Professional musicians play classical compositions on the nadaswaram, a traditional South Indian wind instrument, and enthrall the viewers
programme.desc: ప్రొఫెషనల్ సంగీతకారులు ప్రేక్షకులను అలరించడానికి నాదస్వరం అనే పవన వాయిద్యంలో శాస్త్రీయ సంగీతాన్ని వాయిస్తారు.

programme.title: డివోషనల్ సాంగ్స్

programme.desc: ఒక ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువు, భక్తులు భగవంతుని బోధనలను స్తుతించడానికి పాటలు పాడతారు, ఆధ్యాత్మికత మార్గాన్ని తీసుకోమని కోరతారు.

programme.title: అర్చన
programme.sub-title: Religious priests and devotees offer prayers and perform sacred rituals to seek the blessings of the Almighty at a place of worship

programme.title: పసిడిపంటలు
programme.sub-title: The host talks about the latest tools, methods and technology used in agriculture and shares helpful and insightful farming tips

programme.title: ప్రవచనాలు

programme.desc: சென்னையில் நடைபெறும் நிகழ்வில் விருந்தினர்கள் தங்களின் தனிப்பட்ட கதைகள்-வாழ்வை பற்றிய நுண்ணறிவை பகிர்ந்துகொள்கிறார்கள்.

programme.title: ஆன்மீகம் வளர்த்த அருளாளர்கள்
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of the Almighty and encourages people to follow the path of righteousness
programme.desc: ஒரு மத தலைவர் எல்லாம் வல்ல சர்வவல்லவரின் போதனைகளை விளக்குவதோடு, நீதியின் பாதையில் செல்ல மக்களை ஊக்குவிக்கிறார்.

programme.title: நூல் அரங்கம்
programme.sub-title: The host reviews popular books, takes a look at movies that are inspired by literary works and learns about their favourite novels
programme.desc: புத்தகங்களை ஆய்வு செய்து, இலக்கிய அடிப்படையிலான படங்களை பார்த்து, பிடித்த நாவல்களைப் பற்றி அறிந்துகொள்ளும் தொகுப்பாளர்.

programme.title: மலரும் பூமி
programme.sub-title: Experts shed light on the development of human civilization through agriculture and give insights into the natural methods of farming that help increase the yield
programme.desc: விவசாயத்தின் மூலம் மனித நாகரிகத்தின் வளர்ச்சியையும் விளைச்சலை அதிகரிக்க உதவும் இயற்கை விவசாய முறைகள் பற்றியும் அறிக.

programme.title: தமிழ் தாய் வாழ்த்து
programme.sub-title: The presenter sheds light on the tradition, culture and language of Tamil Nadu, India, to create awareness about the rich heritage of the land
programme.desc: தமிழ்நாட்டின் பாரம்பரியம், கலாச்சாரம் மேலும் மொழி, வளமான பாரம்பரியம் பற்றி விழிப்புணர்வை ஏற்படுத்த எடுத்துக்காட்டுகிறது.

programme.title: கந்த ஷஷ்டி கவசம்

programme.desc: பாலியல் நிபுணர் டாக்டர் காமராஜ்,ஆண்மைக்குறைவு-விறைப்புத்தன்மை பிரச்சினைகளில் ஆலோசனைகளை வழங்கி, பரிந்துரைகளை அளிக்கிறார்.

programme.title: அன்று கண்ட முகம்
programme.sub-title: Aathmanathan, an unbeatable lawyer, vows to remain a bachelor but loses his ground when Kanjana joins as his junior. He falls for her; however, she is in love with his brother
programme.desc: ஆதனப்பன் அவரது இளைய வழக்கறிஞர் காஞ்சனா மீது காதல் கொள்கிறான்.ஆனால் அவள் அவரது சகோதரனை காதலிக்கிறாள்.

programme.title: அண்ணி
programme.sub-title: Ram, a middle-class worker, protests against the injustices of his corrupt owner. But, his good intention brings a lot of troubles for his family
programme.desc: முதலாளியின் அநீதிகளுக்கெதிராக போராடும் நடுத்தர தொழிலாளி ராமின் நல்லெண்ணத்தால் பல சவால்களை சந்திக்கும் அவர் குடும்பம்.

programme.title: அய்யா வழி சாங்க்ஸ்

programme.desc: பக்திப் பாடகர்கள் 19 ஆம் நூற்றாண்டின் தொலைநோக்கு பார்வையாளரான அய்யா வைகுண்டரைக் கொண்டாடி, பாடல்களைப் பாடுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: சுப்ரபாதம்

programme.title: మిర్చి హాట్ సాంగ్స్
programme.sub-title: A robust and engaging compilation of some of the most popular songs composed by different musicians and performed by renowned artists, played back-to-back
programme.desc: వివిధ సంగీతకారులు, కళాకారు కొన్ని హుషారెత్తించే ప్రసిద్ధ పాటల సంకలనాన్ని త్వరితగతిన ప్రసారం చేస్తారు.

programme.title: కొత్త రాగం
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of melodious songs composed and sung by talented artists is played back-to-back to enthral the audience

programme.title: గేమ్ ఛేంజర్ బాంబే ప్రెస్ మీట్
programme.sub-title: The cast and crew of the Indian Telugu-language movie 'Game Changer' get together to promote the project and share their experiences of working on the movie
programme.desc: తెలుగు సినిమా 'గేమ్ ఛేంజర్' తారాగణం, సిబ్బంది తమ సినిమా ప్రచారంలో భాగంగా తమ చిత్రీకరణ అనుభవాలు పంచుకుంటారు.

programme.title: సంక్రాంతికి వస్తున్నాం ఇంటర్వ్యూ
programme.sub-title: The hosts hold an insightful conversation with renowned personalities regarding their upcoming film project, discussing their experiences and hilarious anecdotes
programme.desc: వ్యాఖ్యాత ప్రముఖ వ్యక్తులతో వివిధ అంశాలతో పాటు వారి జీవిత అనుభవాల గురించి తేలికపాటు సంభాషణలో పాల్గొంటారు.

programme.title: డాకు మహారాజ్ బాలకృష్ణ ఇంటర్వ్యూ

programme.title: దిల్రుబా మూవీ లాంచ్
programme.sub-title: The cast and crew of 'Dilruba', a Telugu film, come together to officially launch the movie, sharing behind-the-scenes stories as well as their experiences of working on the project

programme.title: సంక్రాంతికి వస్తున్నాం ట్రైలర్

programme.desc: 'దిల్రుబా' సినిమా విడుదల కార్యక్రమంలో పాల్గొన్న తారాగణం, సిబ్బంది తన తెరవెనుక సంఘటనలు, చిత్రీకరణ అనుభవాలు పంచుకుంటారు.

programme.title: సంక్రాంతికి వస్తున్నాం ట్రైలర్
programme.sub-title: The trailer of 'Sankranthiki Vasthunnam', a 2025 Telugu movie starring Venkatesh, Aishwarya Rajesh and Meenakshi Chaudhary, is presented
programme.desc: వెంకటేష్, ఐశ్వర్య రాజేష్, మీనాక్షి చౌదరి నటించిన 2025 తెలుగు సినిమా 'సంక్రాంతికి వస్తున్నాం' ట్రైలర్‌ను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: డాకు మహారాజ్ ఈవెంట్
programme.sub-title: The cast and crew of 'Daaku Maharaaj' interact with the media and share their on-set experiences at the grand pre-release event of the film
programme.desc: చిత్రం గ్రాండ్ ప్రీ-రిలీజ్ ఈవెంట్‌లో 'డాకు మహారాజ్' తారాగణం, సిబ్బంది మీడియాతో సంభాషించారు, వారి అనుభవాలను పంచుకున్నారు.

programme.title: అష్టాదశ పురాణ్
programme.sub-title: Devotees gather from near and far as a religious leader discourses on holy texts and interprets their messages, encouraging a life of spirituality and righteousness
programme.desc: ఒక ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువు, భక్తుల సమక్షంలో పవిత్ర గ్రంథాల ఆధారంగా ఉపన్యాసమిచ్చి, ధర్మబద్ధమైన జీవితాన్ని ప్రోత్సహిస్తారు.

programme.title: ரிலீஜியஸ் ப்ரோக்ராம்
programme.sub-title: A religious leader delivers a discourse on the teachings of the Almighty to enlighten the devotees and guide them on a path of spiritual growth
programme.desc: மத தலைவர் பக்தர்களுக்கு அறிவூட்டவும், ஆன்மீக பாதையில் வழிநடத்தவும் தேவனின் போதனைகள் குறித்த சொற்பொழிவை வழங்குகிறார்.

programme.title: சுப்ரபாதம்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional songs and hymns in praise of the divine written by various artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: பல்வேறு கலைஞர்களால் எழுதப்பட்ட தெய்வீகத்தைப் போற்றும் பக்தி பாடல்கள் மேலும் கீர்த்தனைகள் தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: கந்தசஷ்டிக்கவசம்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of religious hymns and devotional songs in praise of Lord Murugan written by various artists
programme.desc: பல்வேறு கலைஞர்களால் எழுதப்பட்ட அப்பன் முருகனைப் புகழ்ந்து மத பாடல்கள் மற்றும் பக்தி பாடல்களின் விரிவான தொகுப்பு.

programme.title: தினம் தினம் தரிசனம்
programme.sub-title: The host sheds light on the religious and spiritual significance of various Hindu temples and pilgrimage shrines across India
programme.desc: இந்தியா முழுவதும் உள்ள பல்வேறு இந்து கோவில்கள் மற்றும் புனித யாத்திரை தலங்களின் மத மற்றும் ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவம்.

programme.title: விஷ்ணு சஹஸ்ரநாமம்
programme.sub-title: Hindu religious leaders and devotees chant a Sanskrit hymn listing the 1,000 names of Lord Vishnu to seek his divine blessings
programme.desc: இந்து மதத் தலைவர்களும் பக்தர்களும் விஷ்ணுவின் 1,000 நாமங்களைக் கொண்ட சமஸ்கிருத பாடலைப் பாடுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: ஜி‌கே‌பி / பி‌பி / டி‌டி‌எல்‌எம்
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: தொலைக்காட்சியில் சிறந்ததைக் கொண்டுவருதல்.

programme.title: மதுரை காளியம்மன்
programme.sub-title: Priests and devotees gather at a pious shrine to offer their sincere prayers, worship the Almighty and seek divine blessings
programme.desc: பூசாரிகளும் பக்தர்களும் சன்னதியில் கூடி தங்கள் பிரார்த்தனைகளை வழங்கி, இறைவனை வணங்கி, தெய்வீக ஆசீகளைப் பெறுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: விஷ்ணு ஷேத்திரம்
programme.sub-title: Priests and devotees assemble to perform a ceremonial ritual, offering worship and seeking the divine blessings of Lord Vishnu
programme.desc: பூசாரிகளும் பக்தர்களும் கூடி, ஒரு சடங்கு சடங்கை செய்து, வழிபாடு செய்து, விஷ்ணுவின் தெய்வீக ஆசீர்வாதத்தைப் பெறுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: பக்தி பாடல்கள்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of popular devotional songs in praise of deities performed by eminent artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: புகழ்பெற்ற கலைஞர்களால் நடத்தப்படும் தெய்வங்களைப் போற்றும் பிரபலமான பக்திப் பாடல்கள் தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: சத்குரு
programme.sub-title: Sadhguru, a spiritual guru, gives a discourse on the teachings from the scriptures and urges his followers to walk on the path of righteousness
programme.desc: வேதங்களிலிருந்து போதனைகள் பற்றிய சொற்பொழிவை வழங்கி, பக்தர்களை நீதியின் பாதையில் செல்ல தூண்டும் ஆன்மீக குருவான சத்குரு.

programme.title: ஸ்ரீமத் பாகவதம்
programme.sub-title: A Hindu priest from Tirumala explains the chapters from Bhagavata Purana to the devotees of Lord Krishna in a detailed manner
programme.desc: ஆன்மீகத் தலைவர் ஆழ்ந்த ஞானத்தைப் பகிர்ந்து இந்து கடவுளான கிருஷ்ணரின் வாழ்க்கையை விவரிக்கும் தகவல் உரையை வழங்குகிறார்.

programme.title: அம்மன் கோவில்கள்
programme.sub-title: The host sheds light on the religious and cultural significance of various temples and shrines dedicated to Goddess Amman
programme.desc: தேவி அம்மனுக்கான பல்வேறு கோவில்கள் மற்றும் சன்னதிகளின் மத மற்றும் கலாச்சார முக்கியத்துவத்தை எடுத்துக்காட்டுகிறது.

programme.title: இஷ்ட தெய்வம்
programme.sub-title: Renowned individuals extensively discuss their faith and share experiences of divine providence and miracles in their personal lives
programme.desc: தங்கள் நம்பிக்கையை பற்றி பேசுவதோடு, அவர்களின் வாழ்வில் தெய்வீக நம்பிக்கை-அற்புதங்கள் பற்றிய அனுபவங்களை பகிரும் நபர்கள்.

programme.title: சிவாலயம்
programme.sub-title: At a revered temple in Kerala, priests and devotees unite in devotion, performing sacred rituals and offering heartfelt prayers to Lord Shiva
programme.desc: கேரளாவின் பிரபல கோவிலில், பூசாரிகள்-பக்தர்கள் இணைந்து, சடங்குகளை செய்து, சிவனுக்கு இதயப்பூர்வ வழிபாடுகளை செய்கிறார்கள்.

programme.title: கும்பாபிஷேகம்
programme.sub-title: Devotees in large numbers visit a temple to perform a special ritual in order to synergise and unite the special powers of the deity
programme.desc: தெய்வத்தின் சிறப்பு சக்திகளை ஒருங்கிணைக்கவும் ஒன்றிணைக்கவும் ஒரு சிறப்பு சடங்கை செய்ய பக்தர்கள் கோயிலுக்கு வருகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: ஆர்ஜேஆர் - ஹெர்பல் ஸ்லாட்
programme.sub-title: The host promotes the services offered by RJR Herbal Hospital, where patients receive Ayurvedic treatment to treat various health problems
programme.desc: நோயாளிகளுக்கு சிகிச்சையளிக்க ஆயுர்வேத சிகிச்சையை வழங்கும் ஆர்ஜேஆர் ஹெர்பல் மருத்துவமனை சேவைகளை விளம்பரப்படுத்துகிறது.

programme.sub-title: On a trip aboard the Maharajas' Express, Rohit and Manasi Roy enjoy the cuisines across India while appreciating the rich wildlife of the region

programme.desc: பல்வேறு பிரபலமான இடங்கள் மற்றும் மறைக்கப்பட்ட பொக்கிஷங்களை 10 நாள் பயணமாக இலங்கைக்கு சென்று ஆராயும் தொகுப்பாளர்.

programme.title: எக்ஸ்ப்ளோர் கம்போடியா
programme.sub-title: Sukhmani travels to Cambodia, the land of eternal sunshine and hope. She explores Siem Reap, the city of Angkor, gifted with an enviable focus of history and she fires M16 rifles
programme.desc: Explore the beauty of the peaceful Koh Rong island of Cambodia in the wilderness of the mangroves and the relaxing trip back to Sihanoukville as Sukhmani pampers herself at a spa.

programme.title: 10 டேஸ் ஸ்ரீ-லங்கா
programme.sub-title: Mask making is ingrained in the Sri Lankan tradition. Discovering the history and science behind every handcrafted mask with Sabrina in Ambalangoda
programme.desc: பல்வேறு பிரபலமான இடங்கள் மற்றும் மறைக்கப்பட்ட பொக்கிஷங்களை 10 நாள் பயணமாக இலங்கைக்கு சென்று ஆராயும் தொகுப்பாளர்.

programme.title: தாமு'ஸ் கிச்சன்
programme.sub-title: Chef Damu prepares lesser-known or lost recipes to revive the Tamilian culture. The heritage recipes are not only pleasant on the taste buds but also made from naturally-sourced ingredients
programme.desc: சுவையான, இயற்கை பொருட்களை கொண்ட தமிழர்களின் பாரம்பரியமிக்க அதிகம் அறியப்படாத தொலைந்த உணவுகளை தயாரிக்கும் செஃப் தாமு.

programme.title: ஆஃப் த க்ரிட்
programme.sub-title: Alexandra explores the rugged region of Leh, visiting Thiksey Monastery, Leh Palace and later Shanti Stupa. The next day she sets out for a five-hour drive to the picturesque Pangong Lake
programme.desc: குறைந்தறியப்பட்ட இடங்களை ஆராய்ந்து, அங்குள்ள மக்களுடன் பேசி அவர்களின் பண்பு மற்றும் உணவு பற்றி ஆராயும் தொகுப்பாளர்.

programme.title: சிட்டி ப்ரேக்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Sabrina explores Salzburg, a picturesque city not just known for Mozart but also its beautiful churches, castles and palaces
programme.desc: உலகின் பல நகரங்களுக்கு சென்று உள்ளூர் கலாச்சாரம், பாரம்பரிய உணவுகள், பண்பாடு-அப்பகுதியின் வரலாற்றை ஆராயும் தொகுப்பாளர்.

programme.title: த பக்கெட் லிஸ்ட்
programme.sub-title: The hosts visit Itoshima, a city in Japan's Kyushu Island, to explore its abundance of natural beauty and rich cultural heritage
programme.desc: உள்ளூர் நடவடிக்கைகள் மற்றும் கலாச்சாரத்தில் மூழ்கி உலகின் அழகான இடங்களை ஆராயும் இரு சிறந்த நண்பர்களின் பிணைப்பு.

programme.sub-title: Max, a bionic guinea pig, and his goldfish best friend embark on fascinating adventures after they escape the laboratory and try to fit in the wildlife
programme.desc: एक बायोनिक गिनी पिग, मैक्स और उसके सुनहरी मछली का सबसे अच्छा दोस्त, प्रयोगशाला से भागने और वन्य जीवन में फिट होने की कोशिश करने के बाद आकर्षक रोमांच पर निकलते हैं।.

programme.title: हन्टर एक्स हन्टर
programme.sub-title: Gon Freecss sets out to become a Hunter, an elite professional known for hunting rare monsters and treasures, in the hopes of finding his absent father

programme.title: वन पीस

programme.desc: रबर से बना एक युवक मंकी डी लफी और उसके समुद्री डाकुओं की टीम एक काल्पनिक खजाने को खोजने के लिए एक रोमांचक एडवेंचर पर निकल पड़ते हैं।.

programme.desc: कितेरेत्सु, एक प्राथमिक विद्यालय का छात्र है जो लोगों की मदद करने के लिए अपने आविष्कारों का उपयोग करता है, और कोरोसुके, उसका रोबोट, अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों में भाग लेते हैं।.

programme.title: बायोनिक मैक्स
programme.sub-title: Max, a bionic guinea pig, and his goldfish best friend embark on fascinating adventures after they escape the laboratory and try to fit in the wildlife
programme.desc: एक बायोनिक गिनी पिग, मैक्स और उसके सुनहरी मछली का सबसे अच्छा दोस्त, प्रयोगशाला से भागने और वन्य जीवन में फिट होने की कोशिश करने के बाद आकर्षक रोमांच पर निकलते हैं।.

programme.title: बायोनिक मैक्स

programme.title: हन्टर एक्स हन्टर
programme.sub-title: Gon Freecss sets out to become a Hunter, an elite professional known for hunting rare monsters and treasures, in the hopes of finding his absent father
programme.desc: गॉन फ्रीक्स अपने गायब पिता को खोजने की आशा एक शिकारी बनने का निश्चय करता है, जो एक विशिष्ट पेशेवर है तथा दुर्लभ राक्षसों और खजानों का शिकार करने के लिए जाना जाता है।.

programme.title: वन पीस
programme.sub-title: Monkey D Luffy, a young man made of rubber, and his team of pirates embark on an exciting adventure to find a fabled treasure
programme.desc: रबर से बना एक युवक मंकी डी लफी और उसके समुद्री डाकुओं की टीम एक काल्पनिक खजाने को खोजने के लिए एक रोमांचक एडवेंचर पर निकल पड़ते हैं।.

credits.actor: Mayumi Tanaka (Monkey D Luffy),Kazuya Nakai (Roronoa Zoro),Akemi Okamura (Nami),Kappei Yamaguchi (Usopp),Hiroaki Hirata (Sanji),Mahito Ôba

programme.title: कितेरेत्सु
programme.sub-title: Kiteretsu, an elementary school student who uses his inventions to help people, and Korosuke, his robot, partake in various adventures along with his friends
programme.desc: कितेरेत्सु, एक प्राथमिक विद्यालय का छात्र है जो लोगों की मदद करने के लिए अपने आविष्कारों का उपयोग करता है, और कोरोसुके, उसका रोबोट, अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों में भाग लेते हैं।.

credits.actor: Toshiko Fujita (Kiteretsu),Kazuko Sugiyama (Korosuke),Chieko Honda (Miyo),Yuji Mitsuya (Tongari),Mami Koyama (Korosuke),Mayumi Sho (Miyo)

programme.title: वी बेर बीयर्स
programme.sub-title: Three brother bears, Grizzly, Panda, and Ice, awkwardly navigate life in the San Francisco Bay Area as they try to fit into modern human society
programme.desc: तीन भालू भाई, ग्रिजली, पांडा और आइस, सैन फ्रांसिस्को खाड़ी क्षेत्र में जीवन को अजीब तरीके से जीते हैं, जब वे आधुनिक मानव समाज में घुलने की कोशिश करते हैं।.

credits.actor: Bobby Moynihan (Panda),Eric Edelstein (Grizzly),Demetri Martin (Ice Bear),Charlyne Yi (Chloe),Patton Oswalt (Nom Nom),Jason Lee (Charlie)

programme.title: लूनी ट्यून्स कार्टून्स
programme.sub-title: Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, Porky Pig, Sylvester, Tweety, Road Runner and many others go through a series of funny misadventures
programme.desc: बग्स बनी, डैफी डक, पोर्की पिग, सिल्वेस्टर, ट्वीटी, रोड रनर और कई मज़ेदार और अजीब-गरीब घटनाओं से गुज़रते हैं।.

credits.actor: Eric Bauza (Bugs Bunny/Daffy Duck/Marvin the Martian/Tweety),Jeff Bergman (Elmer Fudd/Sylvester/Ralph Wolf),Bob Bergen (Porky Pig),Fred Tatasciore (Yosemite Sam/Gossamer/Sam Sheepdog),Candi Milo (Granny),Michael Ruocco (Beaky Buzzard)

programme.title: ला फामिल वीज़ी
programme.sub-title: Weasy, an opportunistic weasel with a penchant for burglary, finds himself incubating a large egg, which leads to significant changes in his life
programme.desc: चोरी के शौकीन, अवसरवादी नेवले वीज़ी को एक बड़ा अंडा सेने का काम सौंपा जाता है, जिससे उसके जीवन में महत्वपूर्ण बदलाव आते हैं।.

programme.desc: गॉन फ्रीक्स अपने गायब पिता को खोजने की आशा एक शिकारी बनने का निश्चय करता है, जो एक विशिष्ट पेशेवर है तथा दुर्लभ राक्षसों और खजानों का शिकार करने के लिए जाना जाता है।.

programme.title: वन पीस
programme.sub-title: Monkey D Luffy, a young man made of rubber, and his team of pirates embark on an exciting adventure to find a fabled treasure
programme.desc: रबर से बना एक युवक मंकी डी लफी और उसके समुद्री डाकुओं की टीम एक काल्पनिक खजाने को खोजने के लिए एक रोमांचक एडवेंचर पर निकल पड़ते हैं।.

credits.actor: Mayumi Tanaka (Monkey D Luffy),Kazuya Nakai (Roronoa Zoro),Akemi Okamura (Nami),Kappei Yamaguchi (Usopp),Hiroaki Hirata (Sanji),Mahito Ôba

programme.title: कितेरेत्सु
programme.sub-title: Kiteretsu, an elementary school student who uses his inventions to help people, and Korosuke, his robot, partake in various adventures along with his friends
programme.desc: कितेरेत्सु, एक प्राथमिक विद्यालय का छात्र है जो लोगों की मदद करने के लिए अपने आविष्कारों का उपयोग करता है, और कोरोसुके, उसका रोबोट, अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों में भाग लेते हैं।.

credits.actor: Toshiko Fujita (Kiteretsu),Kazuko Sugiyama (Korosuke),Chieko Honda (Miyo),Yuji Mitsuya (Tongari),Mami Koyama (Korosuke),Mayumi Sho (Miyo)

programme.title: वी बेर बीयर्स
programme.sub-title: Three brother bears, Grizzly, Panda, and Ice, awkwardly navigate life in the San Francisco Bay Area as they try to fit into modern human society
programme.desc: तीन भालू भाई, ग्रिजली, पांडा और आइस, सैन फ्रांसिस्को खाड़ी क्षेत्र में जीवन को अजीब तरीके से जीते हैं, जब वे आधुनिक मानव समाज में घुलने की कोशिश करते हैं।.

credits.actor: Bobby Moynihan (Panda),Eric Edelstein (Grizzly),Demetri Martin (Ice Bear),Charlyne Yi (Chloe),Patton Oswalt (Nom Nom),Jason Lee (Charlie)

programme.title: हैरी एण्ड बन्नी
programme.sub-title: Harry is an aspiring magician who invents elaborate magic tricks to impress others. However, Bunnie, his mischievous stage rabbit, constantly outsmarts him and steals his spotlight
programme.desc: हैरी एक महत्वाकांक्षी जादूगर है जो दूसरों को प्रभावित करने के लिए नए-नए जादू के खेल ईजाद करता है। हालाँकि, बन्नी, उसका नटखट खरगोश, हर बार उसे मात दे देता है और सारी वाहवाही लूट लेता है।.

programme.title: टीन टाइटन्स गो!

programme.desc: நாடு மற்றும் உலகெங்கிலுமுள்ள அரசியல், சமூக பொருளாதார பிரச்சினைகள் மற்றும் நடப்பு விவகாரங்கள் பற்றிய சமீபத்திய செய்திகள்.

programme.title: 1 மணி செய்திகள்
programme.sub-title: The host presents the latest updates and headlines on the social, economic and political issues and shares information on current affairs
programme.desc: சமூக, பொருளாதார மற்றும் அரசியல் பிரச்சினைகள் குறித்த சமீபத்திய புதுப்பிப்புகள் மற்றும் தலைப்புச் செய்திகள்.

programme.title: 2 மணி செய்திகள்
programme.sub-title: The host provides the latest information, advancements and developments regarding various political, economic and social issues
programme.desc: பல்வேறு அரசியல், பொருளாதார மற்றும் சமூகப் பிரச்சினைகள் தொடர்பான சமீபத்திய தகவல்கள், முன்னேற்றங்கள் மற்றும் செய்திகள்.

programme.title: குற்ற சரித்திரம்
programme.sub-title: The host presents a comprehensive analysis of various heinous criminal offences committed by individuals, examining their motives and actions
programme.desc: தனிநபர்களால் செய்யப்பட்ட பல்வேறு கொடூரமான குற்றங்களின் பகுப்பாய்வை முன்வைத்து, நோக்கங்கள்-செயல்களை ஆய்வு செய்கிறது.

programme.title: ஆயுத எழுத்து
programme.sub-title: Kaliammal, a bold and manipulative woman, tries to keep the village under her fist. However, Indra, a young and ambitious sub-collector, vows to put an end to Kaliammal's evil regime
programme.desc: தனது கட்டுப்பாட்டில் கிராமத்தை கையாள நினைக்கும் தைரியமான காளியம்மாளின் ஆட்சிக்கு முடிவுக்கட்டும் துணை கலெக்டரான இந்திரா.

credits.actor: Mounika (Kaliammal),Sharanya Turadi (Indra),Anand Selvan (Sakthivel),Janani Ashok Kumar,Syamantha Kiran,Amzath Khan (Sakthivel),Sreethu Nair (Indra)

programme.title: அனுமன்
programme.sub-title: When Hanuman, an ordinary boy, is blessed with extraordinary powers, he sets out on an adventurous journey and conquers various obstacles
programme.desc: ஒரு சாதாரண சிறுவனான அனுமன், அசாதாரண சக்திகளால் ஆசீர்வதிக்கப்பட்டபோது, ​​அவர் சாகசப் பயணத்தை மேற்கொண்டு தடைகளை வென்றார்.

programme.title: எதிர்நீச்சல்
programme.sub-title: Janani and the women of the household embark on a journey to pursue their ambitions in the wake of Aadhimuthu Gunasekaran's downfall, while navigating the challenges of society
programme.desc: சமூகத்தின் சவால்களை எதிர்கொண்டு, தங்கள் லட்சியங்களைத் தொடர ஜனனியும் வீட்டுப் பெண்களும் ஒரு பயணத்தைத் தொடங்குகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: கயல்
programme.sub-title: Kayal, a selfless woman, earns to provide for her family after her father abandons them. Despite being overwhelmed with responsibilities, she puts her loved ones' well-being before her own happiness
programme.desc: தந்தைக்கு பின் குடும்ப பொறுப்புகளில் மூழ்கியுள்ள கயல், மகிழ்ச்சியை விட அன்புக்குரியவர்களின் நலனையே முன்னிறுத்துகிறாள்.

programme.title: கிச்சன் கலாட்டா
programme.sub-title: The host welcomes celebrity guests as they whip up their signature dishes alongside high-end chef creations, rustic village recipes and much more
programme.desc: விருந்தினர்கள் தங்களின் தனித்துவமான உணவுகளையும், சமையல் கலைஞர்களின் படைப்புகளையும், கிராமிய பாரம்பரிய சமையல் குறிப்புகளையும் மற்றும் பலவற்றையும் தயாரிக்கும்போது, ​​தொகுப்பாளர் அவர்களை வரவேற்கிறார்.

programme.title: பூங்கொடி
programme.sub-title: Poongodi's quest for self-establishment leads her to Saravanan, a man unwittingly controlled by his stepmother's manipulative ways
programme.desc: பூங்கொடியின் சுய தேடல் அவளை தன் மாற்றாந்தாயின் சூழ்ச்சிகளால் அறியாமலேயே கட்டுப்படும் சரவணனிடம் அழைத்துச் செல்கிறது.

programme.title: துளசி
programme.sub-title: A kind-hearted Tulasi strives hard to keep her family together and secure the happiness, well-being and future of her children at all costs
programme.desc: குடும்பத்தை ஒன்றாக வைத்துகொள்ளவும், குழந்தைகளின் மகிழ்ச்சி, நல்வாழ்வு மேலும் எதிர்காலத்தை பாதுகாக்கவும் பாடுபடும் துளசி.

programme.title: மூன்று முடிச்சு
programme.sub-title: Nandini, a vivacious girl, gets married to Suryakumar, a businessman. However, the couple strives to navigate their relationship along with balancing familial responsibilities
programme.desc: தொழிலதிபர் சூர்யகுமாரை மணக்கும் சுறுசுறுப்பான நந்தினி,இருவரும் குடும்ப பொறுப்புகளின் மூலம் உறவை வழிநடத்த முயலுகிறார்கள்.

credits.actor: Swathi Konde,Prabhakaran Chandran,Krithika Laddu,Niyaz Khan,Preethi Sanjiv

programme.title: சிங்கப்பெண்ணே
programme.sub-title: Anandi, a village belle, embarks on a solo journey to fulfil her duties as a daughter and shoulder the responsibilities of her family
programme.desc: ஒரு மகளாக தனது கடமைகளை நிறைவேற்றவும், தனது குடும்பத்தின் பொறுப்புகளை சுமப்பதற்காகவும் ஒரு பயணத்தை தொடங்கும் ஆனந்தி.

credits.actor: Darshak Gowda,Amaljith,G. Gnanasambandam,Rama,Chandrakanth,Lakshmi Raj,VJ Bavithra,Maneesha Mahesh

programme.title: எதிர்நீச்சல் தொடர்கிறது
programme.sub-title: Janani and the women of the household embark on a journey to pursue their ambitions in the wake of Aadhimuthu Gunasekaran's downfall, while navigating the challenges of society
programme.desc: ஜனனியும் வீட்டுப் பெண்களும் ஆதிமுத்து குணசேகரனின் வீழ்ச்சியைத் தொடர்ந்து, ​​தங்கள் லட்சிய பயணத்தைத் தொடங்குகின்றனர்.

credits.actor: Madhumitha Hirannaiah,Kaniha,Haripriya Isai,Vela Ramamoorthy,Sabari Prasanth,Vibhu Raman

programme.title: ரஞ்சினி
programme.sub-title: Ranjani and her close-knit friendship with four men is often frowned upon by society. However, she proves to the world that friendships transcend gender boundaries
programme.desc: ரஞ்சனி, நான்கு ஆண்களுடனான தனது நெருங்கிய நட்பு பாலின எல்லைக்கு அப்பாற்பட்டது என்பதை உலகுக்கு நிரூபிக்கிறாள்.

programme.title: மல்லி
programme.sub-title: A bodacious village girl's life transforms when she bonds with a loving father and his daughter, uncovering the true meaning of love, family and belonging
programme.desc: தந்தையுடனும் அவரது மகளுடனும் பிணைந்து, காதல், குடும்பம் மற்றும் சொந்தம் என்பதன் உண்மையான அர்த்தத்தைக் கண்டறிகின்றனர்.

credits.actor: Madhan Bob,Nikitha Rajesh,Vijay Venkatesan,Poornima Bhagyaraj,Poornima Jayaram

programme.title: மலர்
programme.sub-title: Sisters Malar and Parvathi who share a close bond navigate various challenges in their lives. While her family is of utmost importance to Malar, Parvathi wishes to find a life partner
programme.desc: சகோதரிகளான மலர் குடும்பத்துக்கு முக்கியத்துவம் அளிக்கிறாள், பார்வதியோ வாழ்க்கை துணையை கண்டுபிடிக்க விரும்புகிறார்.

programme.title: புது வசந்தம்
programme.sub-title: While the parents search for a suitable prospect for their daughter Selvi's marriage, she expresses her desire to get married to a joint family
programme.desc: பெற்றோர் தனக்கு திருமணத்திற்கு வரன் தேடும்போது, கூட்டுக் குடும்பத்தில் திருமணம் செய்ய விருப்பம் தெரிவிக்கும் செல்வி.

credits.actor: Nathan Shyam (Thirumurugan),Surjith Ansary (Sundar),Soniya Suresh (Selvi Velmurugan),Shyam Ji (Velmurugan),Vaishnavi Nayak (Keerthi Thirumurugan)

programme.title: మధురం నీ వాక్యం
programme.sub-title: A religious leader offers a reflective discourse on Christianity, highlighting the importance of the Holy Spirit's gifts and their role in nurturing a deeper, more fulfilling spiritual life
programme.desc: ఒక మతప్రబోధకుడు క్రైస్తవమతంపై ప్రసంగించి, పవిత్రాత్మ బహుమతుల ప్రాముఖ్యత, పరిపూర్ణమైన జీవితంలో వారి పాత్రను వివరిస్తారు.

programme.title: జాయ్‌ఫుల్ మిస్టరీస్
programme.sub-title: Devotees gather in large numbers at a church in order to pray the rosary and invoke the divine blessings of Jesus Christ
programme.desc: జపమాల ప్రార్థన చేయడానికి, యేసుక్రీస్తు దైవిక ఆశీర్వాదాలను పొందడానికి భక్తులు పెద్ద సంఖ్యలో చర్చిలో సమావేశమవుతారు.

programme.title: దివ్య పూజ అండ్ ప్రేయర్ ఆఫ్ జూబ్లీ
programme.sub-title: A priest conducts a holy mass and delivers a sermon on various aspects of Christianity and offers a prayer for the jubilee year

programme.title: దివ్యవాక్కు మేరీ సౌజన్య

programme.title: నను మలచిన దేవా

programme.desc: एक आध्यात्मिक पथप्रदर्शक ध्यान के महत्व तथा मन, शरीर और प्रार्थना के बीच संबंध पर विस्तृत तरीके से प्रवचन प्रदान करते हैं।.

programme.title: रूह रिहान
programme.sub-title: A spiritual expert offers profound insights into life's challenges, guiding towards self-realisation, peace and personal growth through deep spiritual understanding
programme.desc: एक आध्यात्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, जीवन की चुनौतियों के बारे में गहन अंतर्दृष्टि प्रदान करते हैं, तथा आध्यात्मिक समझ के माध्यम से आत्म-साक्षात्कार, शांति और व्यक्तिगत विकास की दिशा में मार्गदर्शन करते हैं।.

programme.title: जॉय ऑफ कृष्णा कान्शसनस
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders and devotees sing devotional songs and offer their sincere prayers to Lord Krishna, seeking his divine blessings
programme.desc: धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक और भक्तजन भजन गाते हैं और भगवान कृष्ण से सच्चे मन से प्रार्थना करते हुए उनका दिव्य आशीर्वाद मांगते हैं।.

programme.title: डिवोशनल मेलोज़
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional hymns and songs are played back to back, praising the Almighty and seeking divine blessings
programme.desc: भक्ति भजनों और गीतों का एक व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है, जिसमें ईश्वर की स्तुति की जाती है और दिव्य आशीर्वाद की कामना की जाती है।.

programme.title: जॉय ऑफ कृष्णा कान्शसनस
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders and devotees sing devotional songs and offer their sincere prayers to Lord Krishna, seeking his divine blessings
programme.desc: धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक और भक्तजन भजन गाते हैं और भगवान कृष्ण से सच्चे मन से प्रार्थना करते हुए उनका दिव्य आशीर्वाद मांगते हैं।.

programme.title: डिवोशनल मेलोज़
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional hymns and songs are played back to back, praising the Almighty and seeking divine blessings
programme.desc: भक्ति भजनों और गीतों का एक व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है, जिसमें ईश्वर की स्तुति की जाती है और दिव्य आशीर्वाद की कामना की जाती है।.

programme.title: जॉय ऑफ कृष्णा कान्शसनस
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders and devotees sing devotional songs and offer their sincere prayers to Lord Krishna, seeking his divine blessings
programme.desc: धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक और भक्तजन भजन गाते हैं और भगवान कृष्ण से सच्चे मन से प्रार्थना करते हुए उनका दिव्य आशीर्वाद मांगते हैं।.

programme.title: डिवोशनल मेलोज़
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional hymns and songs are played back to back, praising the Almighty and seeking divine blessings
programme.desc: भक्ति भजनों और गीतों का एक व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है, जिसमें ईश्वर की स्तुति की जाती है और दिव्य आशीर्वाद की कामना की जाती है।.

programme.title: பீமா
programme.sub-title: Sekar admires Chinna and teams up with him to take over the streets of Chennai. However, things change drastically when Sekar falls in love and decides to change his ways
programme.desc: சின்னாவை மதிக்கும் சேகர், அவருடன் இணைகிறார். சேகர் காதலில் விழுந்தபின் விஷயங்கள் கடுமையாக மாறுகிறது.

credits.actor: Vikram (Shekhar),Trisha (Shalini),Prakash Raj (Chinna),Raghuvaran (Periyavar),Ashish Vidyarthi (Police Commissioner),Lakshmi Gopalaswamy (Padma),Thalaivasal Vijay (Saamy),Srinath (Guru),Sampath Raj (Periyavar's Son),Sanusha (Suchitra),Shridhar Kumar (Chinna's Friend),Bala Singh,Tanikella Bharani,Pawan,Kanal Kannan

programme.title: இந்தவார கலகலப்பு
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of hilarious comedy scenes, featuring popular artists, is played back-to-back for the entertainment of the viewers
programme.desc: கலைஞர்கள் பங்கேற்கும் நகைச்சுவைக் காட்சிகளின் தொகுப்பு பார்வையாளர்களின் பொழுதுபோக்கிற்காக தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: மது
programme.sub-title: When Madhu proposes to a pious Mercy, she refuses. However, Madhu continues to follow Mercy and reaches her hometown. Things go wrong when Mercy's bold friend Esther comes to the village
programme.desc: மதுவை காதலிக்க மறுத்த மெர்சியின் சொந்த ஊருக்கு சென்றான் மது. மெர்ஸியின் தோழி எஸ்தர் அங்கு வந்ததால் சிக்கலானது.

programme.title: சாங்க்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of popular and famous songs produced and composed by talented musical artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: திறமையான இசைக் கலைஞர்கள் தயாரித்து இசையமைத்த பிரபலமான பாடல்களின் தொகுப்பு அடுத்தடுத்து இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: தேனும் பாலும்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of melodious songs composed by renowned musicians and performed by various artists in Tamil movies played back to back
programme.desc: புகழ்பெற்ற இசைக்கலைஞர்களால் இசையமைக்கப்பட்டு, தமிழ் திரைப்படங்களில் பல்வேறு கலைஞர்கள் நிகழ்த்திய மெல்லிசை பாடல்கள்.

programme.title: ராமானுஜர்
programme.sub-title: Ramanuja, a learned philosopher, travels the subcontinent and brings his teachings to ardent followers of the Hindu faith
programme.desc: கற்றறிந்த தத்துவஞானியான ராமானுஜம் நாடு முழுதும் சென்று இந்து மதத்தின் தீவிரப் பக்தர்களுக்கு தனது போதனைகளை கற்பிக்கிறார்.

programme.title: ஸ்லாட்
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: இந்நிகழ்ச்சி தொலைக்காட்சியில் மிகவும் சிறந்ததைக் கொண்டுவருகிறது.

programme.title: சாங்க்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of popular and famous songs produced and composed by talented musical artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: திறமையான இசைக் கலைஞர்கள் தயாரித்து இசையமைத்த பிரபலமான பாடல்களின் தொகுப்பு அடுத்தடுத்து இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: நியூஸ்
programme.sub-title: The host presents the latest news stories and developments pertaining to various political and socio-economic issues around the country
programme.desc: நாடு முழுவதும் உள்ள பல அரசியல் மற்றும் சமூக-பொருளாதார பிரச்சினைகள் தொடர்பான சமீபத்திய செய்திகள் மற்றும் முன்னேற்றங்கள்.

programme.title: அழகர் மலை
programme.sub-title: Pugazhendi, an alcoholic man, is the polar opposite of Pandithurai, his elder brother. The latter always protects the former while he gets ridiculed
programme.desc: புகழேந்தி, அவரது மூத்த சகோதரர் பாண்டித்துரைக்கு நேர் எதிரானவர். அவர் எப்போதும் தன்னுடைய சகோதரரைப் பாதுகாக்கிறார்.

programme.title: மன்மதன் அம்பு
programme.sub-title: Convinced that Ambu is unfaithful, Madhan refuses to pay detective Mannar when he reports otherwise. Wanting to make money to help a friend, Mannar decides to fabricate stories about her infidelity
programme.desc: அம்பு துரோகி என்று உறுதியாக நம்பும் மதன், துப்பறியும் மன்னார் வேறுவிதமாக புகாரளிக்கும் போது பணம் கொடுக்க மறுக்கிறான்.

credits.actor: Kamal Haasan (Major Raja Mannar),Trisha Krishnan (Ambujaakshi),Madhavan (Madanagopal),Sangeetha (Deepa),Manju Pillai (Manju Kurup),Usha Uthup (Indira),Ramesh Arvind (Rajan),Urvasi (Mallika),Sriman (Palani)

programme.desc: நாடு முழுவதும் உள்ள பல அரசியல் மற்றும் சமூக-பொருளாதார பிரச்சினைகள் தொடர்பான சமீபத்திய செய்திகள் மற்றும் முன்னேற்றங்கள்.

programme.title: பூ
programme.sub-title: Maari, a young village girl, is madly in love with Thangarasu, her cousin. Later, she sacrifices her love in the hope that he will lead a happy life being married to a wealthy girl
programme.desc: தங்கராசுவை காதலிக்கும் மாரி, செல்வந்த பெண்ணை மணந்தால் மகிழ்வாக இருப்பான் என்ற நம்பிக்கையில் காதலை தியாகம் செய்கிறாள்.

programme.title: இந்தவார கலகலப்பு
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of hilarious comedy scenes, featuring popular artists, is played back-to-back for the entertainment of the viewers
programme.desc: கலைஞர்கள் பங்கேற்கும் நகைச்சுவைக் காட்சிகளின் தொகுப்பு பார்வையாளர்களின் பொழுதுபோக்கிற்காக தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: நியூஸ்
programme.sub-title: The host presents the latest news stories and developments pertaining to various political and socio-economic issues around the country
programme.desc: நாடு முழுவதும் உள்ள பல அரசியல் மற்றும் சமூக-பொருளாதார பிரச்சினைகள் தொடர்பான சமீபத்திய செய்திகள் மற்றும் முன்னேற்றங்கள்.

programme.title: கற்றது சமையல்
programme.sub-title: The host presents a wide range of delicious recipes, demonstrates their preparation and shares useful culinary tips with the viewers
programme.desc: எண்ணற்ற சுவையான சமையல் குறிப்புகளை வழங்குவதோடு, அவற்றை சமைத்து காண்பித்து மேலும், பயனுள்ள சமையல் குறிப்புகளை பகிர்கிறது.

programme.title: ராமானுஜர்
programme.sub-title: The life of theologian and philosopher Ramanujar and his contributions to the Vaishnavism tradition within Hinduism
programme.desc: கற்றறிந்த தத்துவஞானியான ராமானுஜம் நாடு முழுதும் சென்று இந்து மதத்தின் தீவிரப் பக்தர்களுக்கு தனது போதனைகளை கற்பிக்கிறார்.

programme.title: பிரியமானவள்
programme.sub-title: A gentle mother enjoys an idyllic existence alongside her spouse and offspring. However, a resentful companion secretly schemes to seize her fortune
programme.desc: பாசமுள்ள ஒரு தாய் தன் கணவர் மற்றும் பிள்ளைகளுடன் நிம்மதியான வாழ்க்கை வாழ்கிறாள். இருப்பினும், பொறாமை கொண்ட ஒரு நண்பர் அவளது செல்வத்தை அபகரிக்க இரகசியமாகத் திட்டமிடுகிறார்.

programme.title: கண்ணெதிரே தோன்றினாள்
programme.sub-title: A story of love, family bonds, and unexpected twists that unfold when Shiva enters Sakthi's life
programme.desc: ரத்னம் தன் குழந்தைக்கு சொத்து கிடைப்பதற்காக பிறந்த குழந்தைகளான சக்தி மற்றும் அனிதாவை மாற்றிவைக்கிறார், அதன் விளைவாக, அனிதா சரியாக வளராததால் ருத்ரா விதியை எதிர்கொள்கிறார்.

credits.actor: Malavika Avinash,Rekha Krishnappa,Papri Ghosh,Swetha Khelge,Vaishu Jayachandhiran,Jeevan G. Vaa,Kavitha Solairaja,Jayshri Jue,Ramachandran Mahalingam (Rathnam)

programme.title: தென்றல்
programme.sub-title: Story of Thulasi's tragic life turns around when Tamizh falls for her and supports her ambitions. However, their relationship must stand the test of time as their families disapprove of their marriage
programme.desc: தன் கனவுகளை அடைய உதவும் காதலன் தமிழுடனான, துளசியின் காதலை அவர்களின் குடும்பங்கள் ஏற்காததால் உறவு சோதனைக்குள்ளாகிறது .

credits.actor: Shruthi Raj,Deepak Dinkar,Hemalatha,Suzane George,Shanthi Williams,Subhalekha Sudhakar,Sadhana,Aishwariyaa Bhaskaran

programme.title: அங்காடி தெரு
programme.sub-title: Jyothi Lingam, a bright student, leads a happy life in his small village. One day, tragedy strikes when his father, the only earning member of the family, dies in an accident
programme.desc: சிறிய கிராமத்தில் மகிழ்ச்சியாக இருந்த மாணவர் ஜோதி லிங்கம் தனது தந்தை ஒரு விபத்தில் இறந்த போது சோகத்தில் உள்ளார்.

programme.title: कथा सागर
programme.sub-title: An eminent spiritual leader elucidates on various stories from religious discourses, offering guidance and enlightenment
programme.desc: धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, श्रीमान लाल गोविंद दास आध्यात्मिक प्रवचन देते है, जहाँ वह भक्तों को एक पूर्ण जीवन जीने हेतु प्रेरित करने के लिए शिक्षात्मक तरीके से कथा पढ़ते है।.
